description: This Java class defines a custom exception MessageFormatInvalidException used to indicate validation failures in message formats within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for serialization/deserialization to JSON, holds validation error details, and provides a builder for creating instances.

classes.name: MessageFormatInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception indicating message validation failure, with JSON serialization support and a builder pattern.

classes.name: MessageFormatInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A nested static builder class for constructing instances of MessageFormatInvalidException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for MessageFormatInvalidException using provided validation errors.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a MessageFormatInvalidException instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: appendToJson
methods.description: Serializes the exception's validation errors to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with new Ditto headers.
